Libraries Vault uses, copied here so the app works offline and loads nothing from other sites.

supabase.js  @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.3 (dist/umd/supabase.js from npm), MIT: LICENSE-supabase-js.txt
qrcode.js    qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase (dist/qrcode.js from npm), MIT (in the file's header)
fsrs.js      ts-fsrs 5.4.2 by Open Spaced Repetition (dist/index.umd.js from npm, checked against npm's sha512; only
             its last line, the source map comment, taken off), MIT: LICENSE-ts-fsrs.txt. No eval or new Function.
